PAYMENT REQUESTS

Make getting paid simple.

A shareable USDC request that anyone can pay from their own wallet.

Valid for 30 days. Native USDC amounts use 18-decimal precision. The payment reference stays in your request; standard transfers do not carry it on-chain.

THE PAYMENT FLOW

Your wallet.
Your confirmation.

Arc Ledger never asks for a private key, seed phrase or token approval. Payments go directly from the payer’s wallet to the recipient.

A link is a payment request, not a legal tax invoice. Verify the wallet address through a trusted channel.

Request created

INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION

Trust the receipt.
Check the chain.

A transaction hash alone is not proof that your request was paid.

Verify a payment received from someone else by pasting its transaction hash. Checks network, inclusion, recipient, exact amount, timestamp and expected payer if specified. Neither wallet needs to be connected. A standard transfer’s association with a request is chosen locally.

Pay from another wallet or app

Send a native USDC transfer with no data or memo on the network shown above. Give the recipient the transaction hash so they can verify it. The recipient does not need access to the payer’s wallet.

Connect the account that will pay this request.

Review the full recipient address and amount. A shared link can be edited by its sender; confirm it through a trusted channel.

Adding Arc Testnet does not fund your account. Need test USDC? Get test funds from Circle ↗. Choose Arc Testnet and enter the payer’s address. Select a different payer account from the recipient.

Your wallet asks you to approve the transaction. Any payer can pay from their own wallet; the recipient does not need to control it. Arc Ledger does not send anything until the payer clicks pay and confirms in their wallet. Maximum estimated fee: 0.05 USDC.
